title: oncoba macrophylla
intro: Oncoba macrophylla, commonly known as the 'African Bloodwood' or 'Mukungu', is a plant species belonging to the family Salicaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimalarial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Oncoba macrophylla include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a promising candidate for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential medicinal applications.
